# AutoBridge

> Deterministic, air-gapped ANSI X12 856 Advance Ship Notice (ASN) pre-flight validation and auto-repair firewall built for Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3 automotive parts suppliers.

AutoBridge sits as a zero-dependency local sidecar or runs 100% client-side in-browser memory on shipping dock PCs to prevent $5,000-$15,000 OEM receiving dock chargebacks from Ford (AIAG B-10), General Motors (GM 1724), Stellantis, Toyota, and Honda.

## Key Capabilities & Metrics
- **Execution Latency:** <0.2ms deterministic AST lexing and validation with zero third-party cloud dependencies.
- **Air-Gapped Security:** 100% local in-memory processing; zero raw EDI payload transmission or cloud storage (NIST SP 800-171 compatible).
- **Automated Fixes:** Reconciles HL hierarchical loops (Shipment -> Order -> Tare -> Item), verifies `LIN02` qualifiers (`BP` vs `VP`), recalculates `SE01` segment counts, validates `REF*BM` Bill of Lading anchors, and enforces chronological `DTM*011` / `DTM*017` timestamps.
- **Physical Clearance Proof:** Generates printable Driver Dock Clearance Certificates with SHA-256 verification seals.

## Pricing (Self-Serve & Enterprise)
- **Plant Pilot:** $199/month ($189/month billed annually) — Unlimited local pre-flight audits for 1 facility.
- **Production Firewall:** $499/month ($474/month billed annually) — Auto-repair engine, local sidecar folder watcher, and Driver Clearance Certificates for up to 5 facilities.
- **Enterprise Fleet:** $1,499/month ($1,424/month billed annually) — Unlimited facilities, custom OEM rulesets, offline Ed25519 cryptographic licensing.
